hook.name: ShiftHook
hook.description: A fee hook for wstETH/ETH pools that levies a flat configurable toll (in basis points) on the wstETH leg of every swap, covering all four swap shapes (exact-input/output × buy/sell) via both beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas. Toll proceeds are split between an immutable Bus contract (distributes to seat holders) and an immutable Treasury address.
